summary: Experience Türkiye by train on an extraordinary journey from Istanbul to the far east and back. Travel scenic rail routes through Anatolia, including the Kars–Erzurum and overnight Divriği–Ankara journeys, before returning to Istanbul by high-speed train. Along the way, discover ancient Ani, Erzurum, Trabzon and Sümela Monastery, UNESCO-listed Divriği, Ankara and the Hittite capital of Hattusa.

daysList.title: Istanbul | Ottoman Heritage & Old Town
daysList.body:
Welcome to Istanbul!



Your Türkiye by Rail journey begins at 1:00 PM with a welcome meeting with your local guide.



Begin with an orientation walk through Istanbul’s historic Old Town, taking in the atmosphere of Sultanahmet and learning about the city’s Byzantine and Ottoman heritage.



Continue to Topkapı Palace, the former imperial residence and administrative center of the Ottoman sultans for nearly four centuries. Explore its impressive courtyards, royal collections and spectacular views over the Bosphorus.



After the visit, enjoy some free time to relax or explore the surrounding historic streets before gathering for a welcome dinner featuring traditional Turkish cuisine.



Overnight: IstanbulMeals: Welcome DinnerIncluded: Local guide, Topkapı Palace entrance, orientation walk, welcome dinner

daysList.title: Kars | Russian Heritage & Ancient Kars
daysList.body:
After breakfast, take a domestic flight to Kars, gateway to the far east of Türkiye.



Upon arrival, begin your exploration of this fascinating border city with Kars Castle, rising above the historic center and offering panoramic views across the city. Continue to the Church of the Twelve Apostles (Kümbet Mosque), a remarkable 10th century Armenian monument that reflects the many cultural and religious layers of Kars.



Enjoy an orientation walk through the historic city center, discovering Kars's distinctive Russian-era architecture. Wide streets, basalt stone buildings and the city's planned grid reflect the period of Russian rule in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.



In the evening, enjoy dinner at a local restaurant, experiencing some of the distinctive flavors of eastern Türkiye.



Overnight: KarsMeals: Breakfast, DinnerIncluded: Domestic flight, local guide, Kars Castle, Church of the Twelve Apostles, city orientation walk

daysList.title: Kars & Ani | The Lost City of Ani
daysList.body:
Today’s highlight is a journey to the ancient ruins of Ani, one of Türkiye’s most remarkable archaeological sites and once a thriving medieval capital on the Silk Road.



After breakfast, travel from Kars to Ani, passing through the dramatic landscapes of eastern Türkiye. Explore the atmospheric ruins with your guide, including the Cathedral of Ani, Church of St. Gregory, Church of the Redeemer and the ancient city walls.



Walk among the remains of this once-great city, situated dramatically on the edge of a gorge overlooking the border with Armenia. Your guide will bring Ani’s Armenian, Byzantine, Seljuk and Silk Road history to life.



After exploring Ani, return to Kars and enjoy the remainder of the afternoon at leisure. Take time to relax, revisit the city center or discover more of Kars’s distinctive local character.



Overnight: KarsMeals: Breakfast, DinnerIncluded: Private transportation to Ani, local guide, Ani archaeological site entrance, guided exploration of Ani

daysList.title: Kars to Erzurum by Train
daysList.body:
After breakfast, we board the morning train from Kars to Erzurum, beginning another scenic chapter of our Türkiye by Rail journey.



Train journey: 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM



Sit back and enjoy the changing landscapes of eastern Türkiye as the train travels through the dramatic highlands and mountains of the region.



Upon arrival in Erzurum, meet your local guide and begin exploring this historic city, once an important stop along the ancient Silk Road.



Visit the Çifte Minareli Medrese, one of Erzurum’s most impressive Seljuk monuments, before taking an orientation walk through Erzurum’s historic streets.



In the evening, enjoy a special traditional dinner in one of Erzurum’s historic houses, experiencing authentic local cuisine and the warm hospitality of eastern Türkiye.



Overnight: ErzurumMeals: Breakfast, DinnerIncluded: Train journey Kars–Erzurum, local guide, Çifte Minareli Medrese, city orientation walk, traditional Erzurum house dinner

daysList.title: Erzurum to Trabzon | From the Highlands to the Black Sea
daysList.body:
After breakfast, leave Erzurum and travel towards Trabzon, descending from the highlands towards the lush landscapes of Türkiye’s Black Sea coast.



Upon arrival, begin your exploration of Trabzon with a visit to the historic Hagia Sophia, a remarkable Byzantine monument reflecting the city’s long history between the Black Sea, Byzantium and the Ottoman Empire. Continue to Atatürk Mansion, surrounded by gardens and overlooking the city.



Later, explore Trabzon’s lively historic center with an orientation walk through Meydan, Uzun Sokak and the traditional bazaar streets.



End the afternoon at Boztepe, one of the city’s best viewpoints, where you can enjoy panoramic views across Trabzon and the Black Sea.



In the evening, enjoy a relaxed dinner featuring Black Sea cuisine, with local specialties such as kuymak, fresh fish or Akçaabat köfte.



Overnight: TrabzonMeals: Breakfast, DinnerIncluded: Transportation Erzurum–Trabzon, local guide, Hagia Sophia, Atatürk Mansion, city orientation walk, Boztepe

daysList.title: Trabzon | Sümela Monastery & Black Sea Culture
daysList.body:
Today we leave the city behind and travel into the spectacular mountains surrounding Trabzon.



Our highlight is Sümela Monastery, dramatically built into the cliffs of Altındere Valley. Explore the monastery, its chapels, rock church and historic frescoes while enjoying the spectacular forested landscape of the national park.



Continue through the Maçka Valley, stopping in Hamsiköy, a traditional mountain village famous for its local cuisine and particularly its celebrated rice pudding.



Return to Trabzon in the afternoon with time to relax or explore the city independently.



In the evening, enjoy a local Black Sea dinner, completing your two days in Trabzon with the flavors and hospitality of the region.



Overnight: TrabzonMeals: Breakfast, DinnerIncluded: Private transportation, local guide, Sümela Monastery, Altındere Valley, Maçka Valley, Hamsiköy visit

daysList.title: Trabzon to Divriği | UNESCO Heritage & Overnight Train
daysList.body:
After breakfast, leave Trabzon and travel towards Divriği, a historic town known for one of Türkiye’s greatest masterpieces of medieval Islamic architecture.



The highlight of the day is a visit to the Divriği Great Mosque and Hospital (Divriği Ulu Camii ve Darüşşifası), a spectacular 13th-century monument celebrated for its extraordinary stone carvings and architectural detail. The site is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the most important examples of Seljuk-era architecture in Türkiye.



After exploring Divriği and its historic surroundings, enjoy some time to relax before continuing to the railway station.



In the evening, board the 7:49 PM overnight train to Ankara. Settle into your cabin and experience one of the most memorable parts of your Türkiye by Rail journey — travelling through the heart of Anatolia overnight by train.



Overnight: Overnight train to AnkaraMeals: BreakfastIncluded: Private Transportation Trabzon–Divriği, Divriği Ulu Camii and Darüşşifası visit, train to Ankara

daysList.title: Ankara | The Heart of Modern Türkiye
daysList.body:
Arrive in Ankara at approximately 10:30 AM after your overnight train journey. Meet your local guide and begin exploring Türkiye’s capital.



Start with Anıtkabir, the monumental mausoleum of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk and one of the most important symbols of modern Türkiye.



After the visit, continue to your hotel for check-in and some time to refresh.



In the afternoon, visit the Museum of Anatolian Civilizations, home to an exceptional collection tracing thousands of years of Anatolian history, including the remarkable heritage of the Hittites.



Continue with a walk through Ankara’s ancient past, visiting the Temple of Augustus, an important Roman monument, followed by the Roman Baths of Ankara, where you can see the remains of the city's Roman-era public life.



After a full day exploring Ankara from its ancient civilizations to the foundation of the modern Turkish Republic, enjoy the evening at leisure.



Overnight: AnkaraMeals: BreakfastIncluded: Local guide, Anıtkabir, Museum of Anatolian Civilizations, Temple of Augustus, Roman Baths

daysList.title: Hattusa | Journey into the Hittite World
daysList.body:
Today, leave Ankara after breakfast for a full-day journey to Hattusa, the ancient capital of the Hittite Empire and one of Türkiye’s most important archaeological sites.



Explore the monumental ruins of Hattusa, including the Great Temple, Lion Gate, Royal Gate, ancient city walls, and the remains of the royal quarter. Your local guide will bring the Hittite civilization to life as you discover the history of this powerful Bronze Age empire.



Continue to Yazılıkaya, a remarkable open-air rock sanctuary just outside Hattusa, where impressive reliefs depict Hittite gods and religious ceremonies.



After the visit, enjoy lunch featuring local Çorum cuisine before returning to Ankara in the afternoon. The evening is free to relax or explore Ankara at your own pace.



Overnight: AnkaraMeals: BreakfastIncluded: Private transportation, local guide, Hattusa entrance, Yazılıkaya entrance, guided archaeological visit, local lunch.

daysList.title: Ankara to Istanbul by High-Speed Train
daysList.body:
After breakfast, board the high speed train from Ankara to Istanbul and enjoy a comfortable journey through the landscapes of central Türkiye.



Upon arrival in Istanbul, your Türkiye by Rail journey comes to an end at the Istanbul train station. From here, you can continue to your hotel, airport, or onward journey independently.



Meals: BreakfastIncluded: High speed train ticket from Ankara to Istanbul

daysList.title: Welcome to Hanoi | Welcome Meeting & Traditional Vietnamese Dinner
daysList.body:
Upon arrival in Vietnam's charming capital, you'll be transferred to your hotel where you can relax before meeting your fellow travelers.



In the evening, join your tour leader for a welcome meeting introducing the adventure ahead, followed by a traditional Vietnamese dinner at one of Hanoi's carefully selected local restaurants. Enjoy your first taste of Vietnam's rich culinary heritage while learning about local customs and culture.



Meals: Welcome Dinner 



Accommodation :  The Ann Hanoi Hotel & Spa or Similar

daysList.title: Discover the Soul of Hanoi | History • Culture • Local Life • Street Food
daysList.body:
Begin your day with a visit to the Temple of Literature, Vietnam's first national university and one of Hanoi's most beautiful historical landmarks.



Continue to a traditional local tea house where you'll discover Vietnam's centuries-old tea culture while enjoying a relaxing tasting experience.



Stroll around the peaceful Hoan Kiem Lake before visiting the picturesque Ngoc Son Temple, located on a small island connected by the iconic red bridge.



Later, explore the famous Train Street, where local life unfolds just inches from the railway tracks.



In the afternoon, enjoy free time for a tailor-made clothing experience, with skilled Vietnamese artisans creating custom garments to your measurements.



As evening falls, dive into Hanoi's legendary food scene on a guided Old Quarter Street Food Tour, sampling authentic Vietnamese specialties including pho, bun cha, fresh spring rolls, banh mi, egg coffee, and many local favorites.



Meals: Breakfast



Accommodation : The Ann Hanoi Hotel & Spa or Similar

daysList.title: Hanoi to Ha Long & Lan Ha Bay | Luxury Cruise • Sea Kayaking • Overnight on Board
daysList.body:
After breakfast, travel through northern Vietnam's countryside to the spectacular coastline.



Board your premium cruise and begin sailing through the emerald waters of Lan Ha Bay, a quieter and equally beautiful extension of the famous Ha Long Bay.



Following lunch onboard, paddle through hidden lagoons and dramatic limestone formations during an included sea kayaking adventure, allowing you to experience the bay from a unique perspective.



Enjoy sunset on deck before an elegant dinner onboard. Spend the evening surrounded by one of Vietnam's most spectacular natural landscapes.



Overnight: Cruise Ship



Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

daysList.title: Lan Ha Bay to Hanoi | Cruising the Limestone Islands
daysList.body:
Wake up surrounded by breathtaking scenery and enjoy a peaceful morning cruise through the tranquil waters of Lan Ha Bay.



Take advantage of the final hours onboard before returning to the harbor.



Travel back to Hanoi where the remainder of the afternoon is yours to relax or explore independently.



Meals: Breakfast, Brunch



Accommodation : The Ann Hanoi Hotel & Spa or Similar

daysList.title: Hanoi to Hue | Flight Included • Imperial Heritage
daysList.body:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your included domestic flight to Hue, Vietnam's former imperial capital.



Upon arrival, explore the magnificent Imperial Citadel, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that served as the political and cultural heart of the Nguyen Dynasty.



Walk through impressive gates, royal palaces, temples, and beautifully landscaped gardens while discovering Vietnam's fascinating imperial history.



Enjoy the relaxed atmosphere of this historic riverside city during the evening.



Meals: Breakfast



Accommodation : Legacy Hoi An Resort or similar

daysList.title: Hue to Da Nang | Coastal Journey • Beach Resort • Ba Na Hills
daysList.body:
Travel south along one of Vietnam's most scenic coastal routes toward Da Nang.



Visit the famous Ba Na Hills, reaching the mountaintop by one of the world's longest and most spectacular cable car rides.



Walk across the iconic Golden Bridge, dramatically supported by giant stone hands overlooking the surrounding mountains.



Later, check into your beach resort where you can relax beside the ocean before visiting Da Nang's famous Dragon Bridge, particularly impressive after sunset when illuminated.



Meals: Breakfast



Accommodation : Legacy Hoi An Resort or similar

daysList.title: Explore Hoi An | UNESCO Heritage • Tailor Experience
daysList.body:
Today visit the enchanting ancient town of Hoi An, one of Southeast Asia's best-preserved trading ports and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.



Explore its charming pedestrian streets lined with beautifully preserved merchant houses, temples, colorful lanterns, local markets, and riverside cafés.



Visit the town's historic landmarks while learning about its multicultural trading history.



Hoi An is internationally renowned for its exceptional tailoring. Enjoy time to visit one of the city's famous tailor shops where custom clothing can be created in just a day or two.



Spend the evening soaking in the magical atmosphere as thousands of lanterns illuminate the ancient streets.



Meals: Breakfast



Accommodation : Legacy Hoi An Resort or similar

daysList.title: Hoi An to Ho Chi Minh City | Morning Flight • Cu Chi Tunnels
daysList.body:
Transfer to the airport for your included morning flight to vibrant Ho Chi Minh City.



This afternoon, visit the remarkable Cu Chi Tunnels, an extensive underground network used during the Vietnam War.



Discover hidden entrances, command centers, living quarters, and learn about the extraordinary resilience and resourcefulness of those who lived and fought here.



Return to Ho Chi Minh City for an evening at leisure.



Meals: Breakfast



Accommodation : Rex Saigon Hotel or Similar

daysList.title: Mekong Delta Experience | Floating Villages • River Life • Local Culture
daysList.body:
Today journey into the lush landscapes of the Mekong Delta, known as Vietnam's "Rice Bowl."



Cruise along the intricate waterways while witnessing everyday life on the river.



Visit traditional villages, tropical orchards, local workshops, and family-run businesses producing regional specialties.



Experience authentic Delta hospitality while learning about the unique culture that has flourished along the Mekong River for generations.



Return to Ho Chi Minh City in the evening for your final night in Vietnam.



Meals: Breakfast



Accommodation : Rex Saigon hotel or similar

daysList.title: Departure | Farewell Vietnam
daysList.body:
After breakfast, your unforgettable Vietnamese adventure comes to an end.



At the appropriate time, transfer to the airport for your onward flight.



Thank you for choosing Atlas Global Tours. We hope to welcome you again on another immersive journey around the world.



Meals: Breakfast

daysList.title: Nairobi Wildlife Experience | Nairobi & Sheldrick Wild Life | Giraffe Centre
daysList.body:
Welcome to Kenya! Upon arrival at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by your private safari guide before setting off on your first wildlife adventure.



Begin with a game drive through Nairobi National Park, the world's only national park bordering a capital city. Despite its urban setting, the park is home to lions, rhinos, buffaloes, giraffes, zebras, antelopes, and a remarkable variety of birdlife.



Continue to the renowned Sheldrick Wildlife Trust, where you'll learn about the inspiring rescue and rehabilitation of orphaned elephants. Afterwards, visit the Giraffe Centre for a close encounter with the endangered Rothschild's giraffe and discover the conservation efforts dedicated to protecting this remarkable species.



Later, transfer to your carefully selected hotel in Nairobi and enjoy a relaxing evening before your unforgettable safari journey begins.



Wildlife You may see ( 12 ) : African Lion | African Leopard | Black Rhinoceros | Cheetah | Hyena | Masai Giraffe | Reticulated Giraffe | Cape Buffalo | Eland | Common Ostrich | Ostrich | Vulture 



Meals: Lunch | DinnerOvernight: Double Tree By Hilton or Similar ( 4 * )

daysList.title: Amboseli National Park – Evening Game Drive
daysList.body:
After breakfast, depart Nairobi for the scenic drive to Amboseli National Park, enjoying views of Kenya's countryside and rural landscapes along the way. Arrive at your safari lodge in time for lunch and a chance to relax before your first wildlife adventure.



In the late afternoon, embark on an exciting game drive through Amboseli, renowned for its magnificent elephant herds, sweeping plains, wetlands, and breathtaking views of Mount Kilimanjaro. Keep watch for elephants, giraffes, zebras, buffaloes, wildebeests, and, with a little luck, predators such as lions and cheetahs.



Return to your lodge for dinner and a relaxing overnight stay in the heart of the African wilderness.



Wildlife You May See ( 7 ) : African Elephant | African Leopard | African Lion | Black Rhinoceros | Cape Buffalo | Hyena | Cheetah



Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & DinnerAccommodation : Amboseli Sopa Lodge or similar

daysList.title: Full Day Safari in Amboseli National Park
daysList.body:
After breakfast, enjoy a full-day safari in Amboseli National Park, exploring its open plains, wetlands, and acacia woodlands with your expert guide. Renowned for its large elephant herds, the park is also home to lions, cheetahs, buffaloes, giraffes, zebras, wildebeests, hyenas, and abundant birdlife.



On clear days, the snow-capped peak of Mount Kilimanjaro provides a spectacular backdrop for unforgettable wildlife viewing and photography. Enjoy a picnic lunch in the park before continuing your afternoon game drive.



Return to your lodge in the evening for dinner and a relaxing overnight stay.



Wildlife You May See ( 6 ) : African Elephant | African Leopard | African Lion | Black Rhinoceros | Cheetah | Hyena



Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & DinnerAccommodation : Amboseli Sopa Lodge or Similar

daysList.title: Amboseli to Lake Naivasha
daysList.body:
After breakfast, depart Amboseli for a scenic 6-hour drive to Lake Naivasha, passing through the spectacular landscapes of the Great Rift Valley. Upon arrival, enjoy lunch and check in to your lodge.



In the afternoon, embark on a relaxing boat safari across Lake Naivasha, where you may spot hippos, fish eagles, pelicans, and a variety of birdlife. Continue to Crescent Island for a guided walking safari among free-roaming giraffes, zebras, wildebeests, and antelopes in a peaceful natural setting.



Return to your lodge for dinner and a relaxing overnight stay.



Wildlife You May See ( 6 ) : Blue Wildebeest | Hippopotamus | Plains Zebra | Reticulated Giraffe | WaterBuck | Cape Buffalo



Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & DinnerAccommodation : Avian Court Hotel or similar

daysList.title: Lake Naivasha to Lake Nakuru National Park
daysList.body:
After breakfast, visit Hell's Gate National Park, renowned for its dramatic cliffs, volcanic landscapes, and geothermal scenery. Depending on your preference, enjoy sightseeing, a guided walk, or an optional cycling experience through the park.



Continue to Lake Nakuru National Park, arriving in time for lunch and check-in at your lodge. In the late afternoon, embark on an exciting game drive in one of Kenya's finest wildlife reserves, home to black and white rhinos, Rothschild's giraffes, buffaloes, zebras, lions, and a rich variety of birdlife, including seasonal flamingos.



Return to your lodge for dinner and a relaxing overnight stay.



Wildlife You May See ( 9) : African Lion | African Leopard | Black Rhinoceros | Cape Buffalo | Hyena | Reticulated Giraffe | Plains Zebra | WaterBuck | Eland



Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & DinnerAccommodation : Ziwa Bush Lodge or Similar

daysList.title: Lake Nakuru to Maasai Mara National Reserve
daysList.body:
After breakfast, depart Lake Nakuru National Park for the legendary Maasai Mara National Reserve, travelling through the scenic Great Rift Valley and Kenya's picturesque countryside. Arrive at your safari lodge in time for lunch and a chance to relax.



In the late afternoon, visit a traditional Maasai village, where you'll gain insight into the customs, traditions, and daily life of one of Africa's most iconic communities. Enjoy cultural performances and learn about the Maasai's rich heritage before returning to your lodge.



Spend the evening at leisure, followed by dinner and an overnight stay in the heart of the Masai Mara.



Wildlife You may See ( 7 ) : African Elephant | African Leopard | African Lion | Cape Buffalo | Cheetah | Hyena | Plains Zebra



Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & DinnerAccommodation :  Maasai Kimana Camp or Similar

daysList.title: Full Day Safari in Masai Mara National Reserve
daysList.body:
After an early breakfast, set out with picnic lunches for a full-day safari in the world-renowned Masai Mara National Reserve. Explore its vast savannahs and wildlife-rich landscapes alongside your expert guide, maximizing your chances of spotting the Big Five as well as cheetahs, giraffes, zebras, wildebeests, hyenas, and an abundance of birdlife.



Depending on the season, you may also witness the spectacular Great Migration, one of the world's greatest natural events. Enjoy a picnic lunch at a scenic location within the reserve before continuing your afternoon game drive in search of more unforgettable wildlife encounters.



Return to your lodge in the evening for dinner and a relaxing overnight stay.



Wildlife You May See ( 8 ) : African Leopard | African Elephant | African Lion | Black Rhinoceros | Cape Buffalo | Cheetah | Hyena | Plains Zebra



Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & DinnerAccommodation :  Mara Kimana Camp or Similar

daysList.title: Maasai Mara to Nairobi
daysList.body:
After breakfast, bid farewell to the Masai Mara and begin the 5–6-hour scenic drive back to Nairobi, reflecting on the unforgettable wildlife encounters, breathtaking landscapes, and cultural experiences of your Kenyan adventure. Lunch will be enjoyed en route, depending on your travel schedule.



Upon arrival in Nairobi, you will be transferred to Jomo Kenyatta International Airport, your hotel, or your preferred location, marking the conclusion of your Immersive Kenya Safari with Atlas Global Tours.



Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

daysList.title: ANCIENT WONDERS & VILLAGE LIFE
daysList.body:
After breakfast, travel into the heart of Sri Lanka’s Cultural Triangle. Begin with a visit to the UNESCO-listed Dambulla Cave Temple, home to remarkable Buddhist murals and centuries-old statues.



Continue to a traditional village near Sigiriya for an authentic cultural experience, including a bullock cart ride, a peaceful catamaran journey, and a Sri Lankan cooking demonstration followed by a delicious local lunch.



Later, ascend the legendary Sigiriya Rock Fortress. Explore ancient palace ruins, colorful frescoes, and stunning gardens before enjoying breathtaking views from the summit.

daysList.title: ANCIENT MARVELS OF POLONNARUWA
daysList.body:
Journey to the ancient city of Polonnaruwa, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and former royal capital of Sri Lanka. Explore impressive temple complexes, royal palaces, and sacred monuments that reveal the grandeur of the island’s medieval kingdom.



Discover highlights including the Sacred Quadrangle, Rankoth Vihara, Lankathilaka Image House, and the magnificent Gal Vihara Buddha statues, celebrated as masterpieces of ancient stone craftsmanship.



Return to Sigiriya in the afternoon and enjoy a relaxing evening at leisure.

daysList.title: KANDY: THE CULTURAL HEART OF SRI LANKA
daysList.body:
Journey into Sri Lanka’s scenic hill country and the cultural heart of Kandy. En route, visit a fragrant spice garden in Matale, where you'll discover the island’s famous spices and traditional Ayurvedic practices.



Upon arrival, explore the peaceful Kandy Lake and visit the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic, Sri Lanka’s most revered Buddhist shrine.



This evening, experience the energy of a traditional Kandyan cultural performance before enjoying free time to wander Kandy’s vibrant streets and local markets.



ACCOMMODATION: Thilanka Hotel (4-5 Star) Or Similar



MEALS: Breakfast



ACTIVITIES: Matale Spice Garden, Kandy Lake, Temple Of Tooth Relic, Kandy View Point, Kandy Traditional Dance 



PHYSICAL RATING: Medium (Walk Around spice Garden and Kandy Lake)

daysList.title: TEA TRAILS TO ELLA & THE ICONIC NINE ARCHES BRIDGE
daysList.body:
Travel through Sri Lanka’s beautiful tea country, visiting a tea plantation and factory to discover the story behind world-famous Ceylon Tea.



Then board the scenic train from Nanu Oya to Ella, a spectacular journey through rolling tea estates, mist-covered mountains, and picturesque villages.



Upon arrival, visit the iconic Nine Arches Bridge, beautifully set among lush greenery and one of Ella’s most photographed landmarks. Enjoy the rest of the evening at leisure, surrounded by the tranquil charm of the hill country.



INCLUDED : Train Tickets For Nanuoya Ella Train Journey



ACCOMMODATION: Ella Flower Garden (4-5 Star) Or Similar



MEALS: Breakfast



ACTIVITIES: Tea Plantation and Tea Tasting, Scenic Train Journey, Nine Arch Bridge



PHYSICAL RATING: Medium (Walk in Tea plantation and Nine Arch Bridge)

daysList.title: LITTLE ADAM’S PEAK, RAVANA FALLS & RAVANA POOL CLUB
daysList.body:
Start the day with a sunrise hike to Little Adam’s Peak, where breathtaking views of Ella’s rolling hills and tea-covered landscapes await. After breakfast, visit the beautiful Ravana Falls, one of Sri Lanka’s most scenic waterfalls.



In the afternoon, relax at the Ravana Pool Club or, for the adventurous, experience the excitement of the Flying Ravana Zipline. Enjoy a free evening in Ella, exploring its charming cafes and mountain views.



INCLUDED : Complementary Ravana pool Club Voucher



ACCOMMODATION:  Ella Flower Garden (4-5 Star) Or Similar



MEALS: Breakfast



ACTIVITIES: Little Adams Peak, Ravana Water Falls, Ravana Pool Club Activities



PHYSICAL RATING: Medium (Light Hike & Walking Involved)

daysList.title: WILDLIFE & TRANSFER TO MIRISSA
daysList.body:
Wildlife reserve. Keep watch for elusive leopards, elephants, crocodiles, and an array of birdlife as you explore its untamed landscapes.



After your safari adventure, continue to the golden shores of Mirissa. Check in to your beachside resort and unwind by the Indian Ocean, enjoying a relaxing evening in this tropical paradise.



ACCOMMODATION: Triple O Six (4 -5 Star) Or Similar



MEALS: Breakfast



ACTIVITIES: Jeep Safari in Yala, Mirissa Beach



PHYSICAL RATING: Low (Light Walks In Beach)

daysList.title: MIRISSA PARADISE & COASTAL VIEWS
daysList.body:
Wake up to the sound of the Indian Ocean and enjoy a leisurely breakfast. This morning, visit Mirissa’s iconic Parrot Rock and the famous Coconut Tree Hill, where breathtaking coastal views and swaying palm trees create the perfect tropical setting.



The rest of the day is yours to relax on the beach, swim in the warm waters, or enjoy the laid-back atmosphere of Mirissa. Optional activities such as whale watching (seasonal), snorkeling, or surfing are available for those seeking adventure.



ACCOMMODATION: Triple O Six (4-5 Star) Or Similar



MEALS: Breakfast



ACTIVITIES: Parrot Rock, Coconut Tree Hill, Beach Leisure



PHYSICAL RATING: Medium

daysList.title: MIRISSA → GALLE DUTCH FORT → BENTOTA
daysList.body:
After breakfast, follow Sri Lanka’s beautiful southern coastline to Galle. Explore the UNESCO-listed Galle Fort, where colonial architecture, charming streets, and ocean views blend to create one of the island’s most captivating destinations.



Later, continue to the tranquil beach town of Bentota. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day relaxing by the beach, soaking up the peaceful coastal atmosphere.



ACCOMMODATION: Wunderbar Beach Hotel (4 Star) Or Similar



MEALS: Breakfast



ACTIVITIES: Galle Fort, Lighthouse, Bentota Beach



PHYSICAL RATING: Low

daysList.title: BENTOTA - Departure Day
daysList.body:
Enjoy your final breakfast in Bentota. Your private driver will take you to the Colombo Bandaranaike International Airport for your departure.



Carry home the unforgettable memories of your Sri Lankan adventure its warm hospitality, breathtaking, nature, and vibrant culture.



Thank You For Traveling With Atlas Global Tours

daysList.title: Amman City - Welcome Day
daysList.body:

Get ready for an orientation walk through the city’s lively streets. Discover local cafes, markets, and the historic charm of the Jordanian capital. Evening at leisure.



In the evening, savor a street food experience featuring Jordanian favorites such as hummus, falafel, and kunafa — a perfect introduction to the flavors of Amman.



We have Complimentary arrival transfer today.

daysList.title: Jerash, Ajloun & Amman Cooking Class
daysList.body:
After a delicious breakfast, drive to Jerash (approximately one hour) to explore one of the best-preserved ancient Roman cities in the world. Wander through the Oval Plaza, the Temple of Artemis, the North Theatre, and the Colonnaded Street, admiring the grandeur of this archaeological treasure.



Enjoy a traditional Jordanian lunch at a local restaurant near Jerash before continuing to Ajloun Castle, a striking 12th-century fortress offering panoramic views of the Jordan Valley. Return to Amman in the evening for an authentic Jordanian cooking class experience, where you’ll learn to prepare and enjoy classic local dishes.

daysList.title: Amman to Wadi Rum (UNESCO)
daysList.body:
Set out on an unforgettable journey to Wadi Rum, the “Valley of the Moon,” a landscape of breathtaking beauty and ancient history (approximately a 4-hour drive). Upon arrival, embark on a scenic jeep adventure through the desert, visiting iconic sites such as Lawrence’s Spring, the Seven Pillars of Wisdom, dramatic sand dunes, and ancient rock petroglyphs that tell stories of millennia past.



Savor a packed lunch amid the serene desert scenery, then stop at a Bedouin camp to enjoy traditional tea and experience authentic desert hospitality. As the day ends, watch the sun set over the red sands, painting the landscape in golden hues — a perfect moment to relax and reflect.



In the evening, enjoy a traditional Jordanian dinner under the stars, followed by music and dance around the campfire, sharing stories and laughter with the welcoming people of Wadi Rum.

daysList.title: Discover the Wonders of Petra
daysList.body:
Enjoy breakfast at your desert camp before departing for Petra (approximately a 1.5-hour drive). Upon arrival, prepare your camera and begin your exploration of this UNESCO World Heritage site with your expert Tour Guide. Walk through the Siq, a narrow, winding gorge that opens dramatically to reveal the iconic Treasury (Al-Khazneh) — one of the world’s most magnificent archaeological treasures.



Continue your journey through Petra’s ancient streets, admiring the royal tombs, monuments, and rock-carved façades that narrate the city’s storied past. For those seeking adventure, hike to the Monastery (Ad-Deir) — a rewarding 1.5-hour climb offering spectacular panoramic views.



Spend the day immersed in Petra’s timeless beauty, discovering landmarks such as the Pharaoh’s Castle, Triumphal Arch, Amphitheatre, the Siq, and the Treasury, before returning in the evening filled with awe and inspiration.

daysList.title: Dead Sea & Shobak Castle
daysList.body:
In the morning, drive to Shobak Castle (approximately 1.5 hours), an impressive Crusader fortress perched dramatically on a hilltop. Explore its ancient walls and hidden passages, uncovering stories of medieval battles and resilience, while admiring the sweeping views of the surrounding countryside



Continue your day by exploring the breathtaking shores of the Dead Sea, the lowest point on earth. Float effortlessly in its buoyant, mineral-rich waters and indulge in a soothing mud bath, renowned for its therapeutic properties. Enjoy a relaxing lunch at a beach resort or local restaurant, taking in panoramic views of this otherworldly landscape.

daysList.title: Farewell from Jordan – Until We Meet Again
daysList.body:
The Tour Ends where it starts in Amman. 



As you embark on your journey home, may the memories you've gathered during our trip stay with you like treasures in your heart. 



Safe travels and may your path ahead be as enriching and joyful as your time here. Until we meet again, cherish the moments and carry a piece of JORDAN'S spirit with you wherever you go.



Farewell and best wishes for your future adventures!



Warm regards



AGT GROUP LLC TEAM

At 6:00 PM, join your Tour Leader and fellow travelers for a welcome meeting, where you’ll receive important information about your upcoming journey.

Good morning, Great Adventurer ! After a delicious breakfast, begin your day with a visit to one of the world’s most iconic sites the Great Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinus one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, and the mysterious Sphinx and Valley Temple of King Khafre.



Continue your journey through Egypt’s fascinating past at the Grand Egyptian Museum, home to an unparalleled collection of ancient artifacts. Discover the treasures of Tutankhamun, including his legendary golden mask, and gain a deeper appreciation for the artistry and achievements of ancient Egyptian civilization.



Today, you will discover the rich flavors of Egyptian cuisine with a local family. Enjoy a hands-on and authentic culinary experience, learn traditional recipes, and share a delicious homemade meal together. It will be an unforgettable cultural experience and a wonderful opportunity to connect with local life. 



Meal : Breakfast & Cooking Class



Overnight : Ramses Hilton Hotel Cairo or Similar

daysList.body:

Following lunch on board, begin immersing yourself in the rich culture of Aswan. Visit the beautiful Philae Temple. In the evening, enjoy a welcome reception cocktail followed by dinner on board.



Meals : Breakfast , Lunch , Dinner



Accommodation : LUXURY DAHABIA BOAT

daysList.title: NILE CRUISE - Abu Simbel Temple
daysList.body:
Today we depart at 4:30 am to the Sun Temple of Ramses II at Abu Simbel Temples, along with the temple dedicated to his beloved queen, Nefertari. We will spend aproximately 2 hours and drive back to your boat. We will be back at round 2 pm.



These extraordinary monuments, originally discovered in 1813 beneath the desert sands, were meticulously relocated in the 1960s by the Egyptian government in collaboration with UNESCO to protect them from the rising waters of the Nile. The grand temple stands as a powerful symbol of Ramesses II’s legacy, its walls adorned with detailed reliefs depicting his victory at the Battle of Kadesh.Nearby, the smaller yet equally captivating temple honors Queen Nefertari, celebrated for her beauty and importance, and stands as a remarkable tribute to royal devotion.



Meals : Breakfast , Lunch , dinner



Accommodation : LUXURY DAHABIA BOAT

daysList.title: NILE CRUISE - Ob-Kombo and Edfu Temple
daysList.body:
Start your day with a delicious breakfast on board, then set sail to Edfu, home to one of the best-preserved cult temples in Egypt, the magnificent Temple of Horus at Edfu. Later, sail onward to Kom Ombo Temple to explore the unique double temple dedicated to the gods Sobek and Haroeris. Continue your journey sailing toward Edfu temple.



Meals : Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner

Visit the famous Valley of the Kings, the royal burial ground where more than 60 pharaohs of ancient Egypt were laid to rest in tombs carved deep into the desert cliffs.



Today we have 4 hours drive to Hurghada.

title: Immersive Morocco Tour
summary: This 12-day journey through Morocco offers the perfect balance of culture, history and Experience of local Tastes. We don’t believe in ordinary travel — we believe in experiencing Morocco with all your senses. Taste the country through its rich culinary traditions, share stories and meals with welcoming locals, and explore the layers of history hidden in ancient medinas, kasbahs, and desert paths. This journey is designed to connect you with authentic flavors, genuine people, and the timeless heritage that makes Morocco unforgettable. Begin in Casablanca with the grand Hassan II Mosque before continuing to the capital city of Rabat, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Travel north into the Rif Mountains to explore the enchanting blue-washed medina of Chefchaouen, then head to Fes, Morocco’s spiritual heart, where the medieval medina of Fes el-Bali (UNESCO) comes alive with vibrant souks, tanneries, and Islamic architecture.

This 12-day journey through Morocco offers the perfect balance of culture, history and Experience of local Tastes. We don’t believe in ordinary travel — we believe in experiencing Morocco with all your senses. Taste the country through its rich culinary traditions, share stories and meals with welcoming locals, and explore the layers of history hidden in ancient medinas, kasbahs, and desert paths. This journey is designed to connect you with authentic flavors, genuine people, and the timeless heritage that makes Morocco unforgettable. Begin in Casablanca with the grand Hassan II Mosque before continuing to the capital city of Rabat, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Travel north into the Rif Mountains to explore the enchanting blue-washed medina of Chefchaouen, then head to Fes, Morocco’s spiritual heart, where the medieval medina of Fes el-Bali (UNESCO) comes alive with vibrant souks, tanneries, and Islamic architecture. 

This small-group expedition is designed to immerse you deeply in the land, authentic local communities, and captivating heritage. Enjoy relaxed pacing, intimate family meals, and the guidance of dedicated experts.

daysList.title: Casablanca | Arrival & Coastal Elegance
daysList.body:
Welcome to Casablanca. Today welcome meeting at 1 pm. Meet with your travel mates and your tour Leader/Guide. Visit the stunning Hassan II Mosque, stroll the Corniche, and enjoy a seaside welcome dinner featuring fresh Atlantic seafood and Moroccan wines. 



Stay in Casablanca tonight.

daysList.title: Rabat | Royal Heritage
daysList.body:
Travel to Rabat, Morocco’s refined capital. Discover the Kasbah of the Udayas, Hassan Tower, and Royal Palace gates. Enjoy a home-style lunch hosted by a local family and learn how to prepare traditional mint tea.



Overnight in Rabat

daysList.title: Chefchaouen | The Blue Pearl
daysList.body:
Journey into the Rif Mountains to the enchanting blue-washed town. Wander painted alleyways, meet local artisans, and taste goat cheese, olives, and regional breads. Sunset photography from the Spanish Mosque hill.



Overnight in Chefchaouen.

daysList.title: Fes | Spiritual & Culinary Heart
daysList.body:
Morning free for last strolls and photos in Chefchaouen. Drive to Fes, Morocco’s spiritual and cultural heart.



Guided walk through the medieval medina and tanneries



Overnight in Fes.

daysList.title: Fes | Spiritual & Culinary Heart
daysList.body:
Guided walking tour of Fes el-Bali Medina (UNESCO), the world’s largest car-free urban area.



Visit a pottery cooperative and traditional mosaic workshop. Hands-on cooking class inside a riad: tagine, pastilla, and Moroccan salads. 



Evening Andalusian music performance. 



Overnight in Fes.

daysList.title: Midelt | Atlas Mountain Life
daysList.body:
Cross cedar forests and Berber villages of the Middle Atlas. Stop to see wild Barbary macaques. In Midelt, enjoy a farm-to-table dinner with local Amazing hosts and learn about mountain traditions.



Overnight in Midelt.

daysList.title: Merzouga & Sahara | Desert Immersion
daysList.body:
Enter the golden dunes for a true Sahara experience. Ride camels across sunset sands, then arrive at a luxury desert camp. Dinner under the stars with live Gnawa drums and storytelling by nomads.



Overnight in Sahara desert Camp

daysList.title: Todra Gorge | Oasis Walks & Berber Encounters
daysList.body:
Morning arrival through the palm groves of Tinghir, one of Morocco’s most beautiful desert oases. Guided walk along irrigation channels and mud-brick ksar villages.



Explore Todra’s towering canyon walls, rising up to 300 meters. Lunch with a local Amazing family featuring fresh bread, olive oil, dates, and tagine.



Afternoon option: light canyon hike or photography session capturing shifting desert light.



Overnight in a boutique kasbah lodge near the gorge.

daysList.title: Dades Valley | Valleys, Kasbahs & Scenic Routes
daysList.body:
Scenic drive along the “Road of a Thousand Kasbahs.” Visit rose-growing villages (seasonal harvest May–June) and women’s cooperatives producing rosewater.



Short hike through rock formations known as the “Monkey Fingers.” Traditional lunch in a valley guesthouse overlooking dramatic red cliffs.



Cultural stop in a nomadic settlement to learn about desert survival traditions and tea rituals.



Sunset viewpoints over winding mountain roads and layered canyon landscapes.

daysList.title: Ait Benhaddou & Atlas Crossing
daysList.body:
Travel the legendary Caravan Road. Stop at Ait Benhaddou, a UNESCO-listed earthen village famous for film sets. Cross the High Atlas Mountains with panoramic passes and tea stops.



Overnight in Ait Benhaddou

daysList.title: Marrakech | Red City Magic
daysList.body:
Discover Marrakech’s palaces, gardens, and souks. Highlights include Bahia Palace, Majorelle Garden, and spice markets. Evening food tour through Jemaa el-Fnaa tasting street delicacies like snail soup, msemen, and fresh juices.



Overnight in Marrakech

daysList.title: Departure Day
daysList.body:
As you embark on your journey home, may the memories you've gathered during our trip stay with you like treasures in your heart.



Safe travels and may your path ahead be as enriching and joyful as your time here. Until we meet again, cherish the moments and carry a piece of Morocco's spirit with you wherever you go.



Farewell and best wishes for your future adventures!



Warm regards

daysList.title: Budapest City - Exploring Old Town ( UNESCO )
daysList.body:
Welcome to Budapest, Hungary’s captivating capital where history meets modern charm. Your welcome meeting is scheduled for 1:00 PM.



If time allows, visit the Hungarian Parliament Building, a stunning architectural icon — advance booking is recommended. Later, explore St. Stephen’s Basilica and climb to the dome for breathtaking city views.



In the evening, enjoy a Danube River cruise as Budapest lights up at night, followed by dinner at a local restaurant or Ruin Bar in the Jewish Quarter, such as Mazel Tov or Szimpla Kert. End the night with a leisurely stroll along the Danube promenade or experience the city’s vibrant nightlife.

daysList.title: PECS CITY - Explore old town ( UNESCO )
daysList.body:
This morning, depart Budapest and enjoy a scenic 2.5-hour drive to Pécs, a charming Hungarian town rich in history and culture.



Begin your exploration with a visit to the magnificent Pécs Cathedral, a masterpiece of Romanesque architecture. Continue to the Early Christian Necropolis, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, where you’ll uncover fascinating stories from the city’s ancient past.



Afterward, enjoy a leisurely stroll through Pécs’ picturesque streets, filled with colorful buildings, local shops, and inviting cafés. In the evening, dine at a local restaurant along Kossuth Lajos Street, known for its warm atmosphere and delicious regional cuisine.

daysList.title: BELGRADE CITY - Explore old city
daysList.body:
Begin your day with a guided walking tour, Where the heart of Belgrade will unfold before you. Stroll through the bustling Republic Square, where history and culture converge, and wander along Knez Mihailova Street, the city's vibrant pedestrian thoroughfare. Let the charm of the city lead you to the peaceful Kalemegdan Park, perched above the meeting of the Danube and Sava Rivers. Here, in the shadow of the Belgrade Fortress, you'll witness stunning views that tell tales of centuries past.



As evening falls, immerse yourself in the atmosphere of Skadarska Street, Belgrade's bohemian heart, where traditional restaurants serve up authentic Serbian cuisine, and the air is thick with the hum of folk music. Here, among the cobblestone streets and colorful facades, you’ll join your group for a warm and welcoming dinner, embracing the city's rich culinary heritage in one of its most iconic quarters.

daysList.title: TARA NAT. PARK - Hiking Day
daysList.body:
Depart Belgrade and travel toward the breathtaking Tara National Park, a natural gem in western Serbia. Known for its dense forests, dramatic canyons, and serene lakes, Tara offers a peaceful escape into nature.



Upon arrival, explore scenic viewpoints such as Banjska Stena, where sweeping vistas overlook the Drina River and surrounding mountains. Enjoy a leisurely hike through pine-scented trails, keeping an eye out for local wildlife, including deer and eagles.



In the evening, relax at your mountain lodge, surrounded by tranquil landscapes. Savor a hearty local dinner, and unwind under the starry sky—a perfect end to a day immersed in nature’s beauty.

daysList.title: SARAJEVO CITY - Visit Sokulu Bridge ( UNESCO )
daysList.body:
Today, journey to Sarajevo, a city where history and culture converge in remarkable harmony. As you stroll through the cobblestone streets of the Old Town (Baščaršija), feel the city’s vibrant spirit and timeless charm.



Visit the Latin Bridge, the historic site that marked the beginning of World War I, and take a moment to reflect on the events that shaped the 20th century. Continue exploring Sarajevo’s unique architectural blend—mosques, synagogues, and churches standing side by side—symbolizing centuries of coexistence and resilience.



Enjoy free time to savor Bosnian coffee or taste local delicacies like ćevapi before gathering for a cozy evening in this unforgettable city.

daysList.title: Sarajevo to the Adriatic Coast via Mostar
daysList.body:
Today, we travel toward the shimmering Adriatic coast, stopping in the heart of Herzegovina to explore the enchanting city of Mostar. As you wander through the Old Town, its cobblestone streets and Ottoman architecture transport you back in time.



Pause at the Stari Most (Old Bridge)—Mostar’s crown jewel—an elegant arch spanning the emerald Neretva River, symbolizing unity and resilience through the centuries. Stroll through the vibrant čaršija (market), where local artisans display their crafts and the aroma of freshly brewed coffee fills the air.



Take time to enjoy a traditional Bosnian meal at a riverside café, watching the reflection of the bridge dance on the water. With its blend of history, culture, and scenic beauty, Mostar offers an unforgettable glimpse into the soul of the Balkans.

daysList.title: SPLIT CITY - The Pearl of the Dalmatian Coast
daysList.body:
Today, embark on a guided tour of the magnificent Diocletian’s Palace, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of Europe’s most remarkable Roman landmarks. Constructed from the gleaming white stone of Brač Island, this imperial residence stands as a lasting symbol of ancient grandeur and craftsmanship.



After your tour, enjoy leisure time to explore Split’s enchanting streets, where history and coastal charm intertwine. Stroll along the lively Riva promenade, discover hidden courtyards, or relax at a seaside café as you take in the timeless beauty of this Adriatic treasure.

daysList.title: DUBROVNIK CITY - The Jewel of the Adriatic
daysList.body:
Enclosed by majestic stone walls and crowned with a sea of terracotta rooftops, this UNESCO World Heritage city radiates timeless charm and cinematic beauty—famously known as “King’s Landing.”



The descent from the mountains offers breathtaking views of the Adriatic, setting the tone for an unforgettable day. Begin with a guided walking tour of the Old Town, where every cobblestone whispers a story of centuries past. Explore its narrow alleyways, walk along the ancient city walls, and take in sweeping vistas of sea and sky. Later, enjoy fresh seafood at a local tavern, or take a refreshing dip in Dubrovnik’s crystal-clear waters—a perfect blend of history, culture, and coastal serenity.

daysList.title: KOTOR CITY - The Timeless Beauty of Kotor
daysList.body:
Arrive in Kotor after a scenic drive through Montenegro’s lush landscapes. Nestled between dramatic mountains and a sparkling bay, this hidden gem enchants with its ancient citadel and charming, winding streets.



Join your expert guide for a walking tour of the Old Town, where centuries of history come alive. Afterwards, enjoy free time to explore Kotor at your own pace—wander its narrow alleys, relax in rustic cafés, and soak in the breathtaking coastal views.

daysList.title: Departure Day - Farewell from the Balkans
daysList.body:
As your journey comes to an end, may the memories you’ve created throughout the Balkans remain with you as treasured keepsakes of history, culture, and breathtaking landscapes.



We wish you safe travels and hope your path ahead is as enriching and joyful as your time spent exploring these remarkable destinations. Until we meet again, carry the spirit of the Balkans with you, wherever your adventures take you.



Farewell and best wishes for all your future journeys!

daysList.body:

Enjoy the breathtaking scenery and the serene atmosphere as you delve into the cultural heritage of this remarkable region!



On your way to Haghpat, visit two iconic monasteries founded by King Ashot I in 874 AD. These sites served as both pilgrimage destinations and places of exile for disgraced Armenian noblemen. Continue your drive to the charming, forested town of Dilijan. Finally, venture into the heart of the forest to uncover the enchanting Haghartsin Monastery



Join a welcoming Molokan family for a delightful dinner, where you'll get to immerse yourself in their unique beliefs and traditions. Savor delicious Russian-influenced dishes, including hearty borscht, flavorful pirozhki (savory pies), and warm tea served from a traditional samovar. Explore the 6th-century church, a masterpiece of early Georgian architecture, and feel the serene atmosphere that surrounds this sacred site.



Next, make your way to Svetitskhoveli Cathedral, renowned for its stunning architecture and deep spiritual significance. Wander through the intricate frescoes and marvel at the impressive columns. Take your time to appreciate the history and culture that this UNESCO World Heritage site embodies.

daysList.body:
Ahlan wa Sahlan! Welcome to Cairo, the vibrant capital of Egypt. Upon arrival at Cairo International Airport, please look for our Atlas Global Tours sign — our representative will greet you and provide your complimentary transfer to the hotel.


At 6:00 pm, join your Tour Leader and fellow travelers for a welcome meeting, where you’ll receive important information about your upcoming journey.


Your Tour Leader will introduce you to the city with a short orientation walk. If you’re not too tired after your travels, you’re invited to join an optional group dinner at a traditional Egyptian restaurant — a perfect opportunity to enjoy local flavors and get to know your travel companions.

daysList.title: Grand Egyptian Museum & Cooking Class
daysList.body:
Good morning, Great Adventurer ! After a delicious breakfast, begin your day with a visit to one of the world’s most iconic sites — the Great Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinus one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, and the mysterious Sphinx and Valley Temple of King Khafre. 



Continue your journey through Egypt’s fascinating past at the Grand Egyptian Museum, home to an unparalleled collection of ancient artifacts. Discover the treasures of Tutankhamun, including his legendary golden mask, and gain a deeper appreciation for the artistry and achievements of ancient Egyptian civilization.



Today, you will discover the rich flavors of Egyptian cuisine with a local family. Enjoy a hands-on and authentic culinary experience, learn traditional recipes, and share a delicious homemade meal together. It will be an unforgettable cultural experience and a wonderful opportunity to connect with local life.



Meal : Breakfast & Cooking Class



Overnight : Ramses Hilton Hotel Cairo or Similar

daysList.title: NILE CRUISE - Morning Flight to Aswan
daysList.body:
After a short morning flight from Cairo to Aswan, you will arrive and transfer to your Nile cruise, where you will check in before lunch.



Following lunch on board, begin immersing yourself in the rich culture of Aswan. Visit the beautiful Philae Temple. In the evening, enjoy a welcome reception cocktail followed by dinner on board.



Meals : Breakfast , Lunch , Dinner



Accommodation : LUXURY DAHABIA BOAT

daysList.title: NILE CRUISE - Abu Simbel Temple
daysList.body:
Today we depart at 4:30 am to the Sun Temple of Ramses II at Abu Simbel Temples, along with the temple dedicated to his beloved queen, Nefertari. We will spend aproximately 2 hours and drive back to your boat. We will be back at round 2 pm.   



These extraordinary monuments, originally discovered in 1813 beneath the desert sands, were meticulously relocated in the 1960s by the Egyptian government in collaboration with UNESCO to protect them from the rising waters of the Nile. The grand temple stands as a powerful symbol of Ramesses II’s legacy, its walls adorned with detailed reliefs depicting his victory at the Battle of Kadesh.Nearby, the smaller yet equally captivating temple honors Queen Nefertari, celebrated for her beauty and importance, and stands as a remarkable tribute to royal devotion.



Meals : Breakfast , Lunch , dinner



Accommodation : LUXURY DAHABIA BOAT

daysList.title: NILE CRUISE - Ob-Kombo and Edfu Temple
daysList.body:
Start your day with a delicious breakfast on board, then set sail to Edfu, home to one of the best-preserved cult temples in Egypt, the magnificent Temple of Horus at Edfu. Later, sail onward to Kom Ombo Temple to explore the unique double temple dedicated to the gods Sobek and Haroeris. Continue your journey sailing toward Edfu temple. 



Meals : Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner



Accommodation : LUXURY DAHABIA BOAT

daysList.body:

Visit the famous Valley of the Kings, the royal burial ground where more than 60 pharaohs of ancient Egypt were laid to rest in tombs carved deep into the desert cliffs.



Today we have 4 hours to hurghada.

daysList.body:
Arrive in the captivating seaside capital, Muscat, where your journey begins at 1:00 PM with a welcome meeting. Meet your expert tour guide and fellow travelers as you prepare to embark on an unforgettable adventure through the heart of Oman.



Start your exploration with a visit to the magnificent Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque, an architectural masterpiece and one of the largest mosques in the world. Continue to the Royal Opera House, a stunning example of Omani elegance and cultural pride.



As evening descends, stroll through the lively Mutrah Souq, one of the oldest marketplaces in the Arab world, filled with the scent of frankincense and vibrant displays of traditional crafts and spices.



Conclude your day with a welcome dinner at Kargeen Café, where you’ll savor a delightful blend of traditional Omani and modern cuisine in a beautiful open-air garden setting—a perfect introduction to Oman’s warmth and hospitality.

daysList.title: Journey to Jebel Akhdar – The Green Mountain
daysList.body:
This morning, depart for Jebel Akhdar, the legendary “Green Mountain” of Oman, renowned for its breathtaking vistas, cool climate, and terraced farms. Enjoy a scenic drive through winding mountain roads, offering panoramic views of deep canyons and rugged cliffs.



In the afternoon, set out on a guided hike through the region’s picturesque terraced orchards and traditional villages, where you can witness local life and centuries-old farming practices.



As evening falls, relax and unwind at your mountain resort or eco-lodge, surrounded by tranquil landscapes and fresh mountain air—an idyllic retreat in the heart of Oman’s highlands.

daysList.title: NIZWA CITY - Exploring the Falaj Daris ( UNESCO )
daysList.body:
This morning, embark on a scenic 1.5-hour drive to Nizwa, one of Oman’s most historic and culturally rich cities. Begin your exploration with a visit to the impressive Nizwa Fort, renowned for its massive circular tower and commanding views of the old town. Stroll through the bustling Nizwa Souq, where you’ll find traditional crafts, silver jewelry, and aromatic spices. We can join for Pottery demonstration class and watch Nizwa Famous pottery master who creates unique potteries. 



In the afternoon, visit Falaj Daris, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, showcasing Oman’s ingenious aflaj irrigation system, an ancient network that continues to sustain life in the desert. Continue to Bahla Fort, another UNESCO-listed treasure, and marvel at its fascinating blend of defensive architecture and history dating back to the 13th century.



As the day draws to a close, enjoy an authentic Omani dinner with a local family, where you’ll experience true Omani hospitality and savor traditional dishes such as shuwa (slow-cooked lamb) and majboos (spiced rice with meat or seafood)—a perfect way to connect with local culture and end the day on a memorable note.

daysList.title: Adventure in the Wahiba Sands Desert
daysList.body:
This morning, embark on a 4.5-hour drive to Wahiba Sands, a breathtaking expanse of golden dunes that stretch endlessly across the horizon. Upon arrival, immerse yourself in the majestic desert landscape, where the shifting sands create an ever-changing panorama.



In the afternoon, experience the thrill of camel riding or an exhilarating 4x4 dune bashing adventure, gliding across the towering dunes for an unforgettable taste of desert life.



As evening falls, settle into your desert camp, surrounded by the serene beauty of the wilderness. Enjoy a traditional Omani dinner under the stars, accompanied by warm hospitality and the tranquil rhythm of the desert night—a truly magical experience.

daysList.title: From Wadi Bani Khalid to Ras Al Jinz – Nature and Coastal Wonders
daysList.body:
This morning, embark on a scenic 2-hour drive to Wadi Bani Khalid, one of Oman’s most picturesque wadis. As you wind through the Eastern Hajar Mountains, take in breathtaking views of quaint villages perched among the rocky peaks. Upon arrival, enjoy a refreshing swim in the crystal-clear turquoise pools, shaded by lush palms and framed by dramatic cliffs—an idyllic oasis of serenity.



Continue to the coastal city of Sur, famed for its centuries-old dhow shipyard, where traditional wooden boats are still handcrafted using time-honored techniques. In the afternoon, journey onward to Ras Al Jinz, home to Oman’s renowned turtle reserve. Here, you’ll learn about the country’s vital turtle conservation efforts and, in the evening, have the option to join a guided night tour to witness the unforgettable sight of green turtles nesting along the moonlit shore—a truly magical end to the day.

daysList.title: From Qalhat to the Bimmah Sinkhole – A Journey Through Nature and History
daysList.body:
Begin your day with a visit to Qalhat, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that once thrived as a major trading hub during the 14th and 15th centuries. This ancient port city played a vital role in connecting Oman with Africa, India, and beyond, leaving behind traces of its rich maritime legacy.



Continue your journey through Oman’s rugged coastal landscapes to Hawiyat Najm Park, home to the spectacular Bimmah Sinkhole. Formed by natural limestone erosion, this turquoise-water oasis is one of Oman’s geological marvels. Take a moment to relax by the shimmering pool or dip your feet in the refreshing waters while admiring the stunning surroundings.



As evening falls, return to Muscat, where you can unwind and reflect on the day’s adventures—an ideal way to close your journey through Oman’s blend of natural beauty and historical heritage.

daysList.title: SAHAR CITY - Exploring Old Town
daysList.body:
Explore the historic Sohar Fort, a beautifully restored landmark that once stood as a key stronghold along Oman’s northern coast. Wander through its impressive courtyards and towers while uncovering stories of ancient trade and maritime heritage.



Afterward, immerse yourself in authentic Omani culture with visits to nearby villages, where you’ll experience the warmth of local hospitality and witness traditional crafts and daily life firsthand—a perfect glimpse into the timeless rhythm of rural Oman.

daysList.title: Welcome to Dubai – Where Tradition Meets Modern Marvels
daysList.body:
After a 2-hour drive from Sohar, begin your Dubai adventure in Old Dubai, where history and culture come alive. Stroll through the Spice Souk, filled with the rich aromas of saffron, cinnamon, and cardamom, and continue to the dazzling Deira Gold Souk, famous for its intricate craftsmanship and some of the purest gold jewelry in the world.



Enjoy an authentic Emirati lunch at the Sheikh Mohammed Centre for Cultural Understanding, where you’ll not only savor traditional dishes but also gain meaningful insights into the local customs and way of life through engaging conversations with your hosts.



In the afternoon, experience Dubai’s modern splendor with a visit to the Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest building. Ascend to its observation deck for breathtaking 360-degree views that stretch from the shimmering coastline to the golden desert—an unforgettable finale to a day that beautifully blends Dubai’s rich heritage with its futuristic skyline.

daysList.title: Discover the Grandeur of Abu Dhabi – The Cultural Heart of the Emirates
daysList.body:
Embark on a journey to Abu Dhabi, one of the world’s most sophisticated and prosperous cities, known for its striking skyline, architectural innovation, and deep appreciation for art and culture.



Begin your exploration at the Abu Dhabi Falcon Hospital and Museum, where you’ll gain fascinating insight into the care and significance of these majestic birds of prey, revered in Emirati tradition and history.



Continue to the magnificent Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Abu Dhabi’s most iconic landmark and a true masterpiece of Islamic architecture. Capable of accommodating over 41,000 worshippers, the mosque is adorned with exquisite marble, glittering chandeliers, and the world’s largest handwoven Persian carpet. Take time to admire its serene beauty and reflect on its spiritual and cultural importance.



Conclude your day at the world-renowned Louvre Abu Dhabi, the largest art museum in the Arabian Peninsula. Explore its vast collection that bridges Eastern and Western artistic traditions, housed beneath a breathtaking geometric dome that filters sunlight like stars through the desert sky—a fitting finale to your day in this remarkable city.

daysList.title: Farewell from Oman & The Emirates
daysList.body:
As your incredible journey comes to an end, may the memories you’ve created across Oman and the Emirates remain as timeless treasures in your heart. From golden deserts and serene wadis to vibrant cities and architectural marvels, each experience tells a story worth remembering.



We wish you safe travels and hope your path ahead is as inspiring and joyful as the moments you’ve shared here. Until we meet again, carry with you the warmth, spirit, and beauty of this remarkable region wherever your adventures may lead.



Farewell and best wishes for all your future journeys.



Warm regards, AGT GROUP LLC TEAM
